info.title: Haloid API
info.description: Haloid's own REST API. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details; dates are RFC 3339; lists are cursor-paginated.

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/admin/audit`: newest first.
`GET /api/v2/admin/files/deleted`: deleted files, retained until purged.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v2/admin/files/{id}/purge`: destroy row and bytes, by a job
that retries if storage fails partway.

404.description: No such file
No such file

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/admin/users`. Administrators.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Part of a username or email.

patch.summary:
`PATCH /api/v2/admin/users/{id}`: role and status. A ban signs the user
out everywhere. No one can demote or ban themselves.

404.description: No such user

422.description: A bad role or status, or a change to yourself

post.summary: `POST /api/v2/albums`: a new album, owned by the caller.

422.description: Bad fields, a bad parent, or nested too deep

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/albums/{id}`.

404.description: Not there, or not for this caller

422.description: Bad parameters

parameters.name: contents

404.description: No such album, or not this caller's to delete

422.description: `contents` missing or not keep/delete

200.description: The album as it now is

404.description: No such album, or not this caller's to change

422.description: Bad fields, or a move into itself or too deep

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/albums/{id}/files`, in the owner's order by default.

404.description: Not there, or not for this caller

422.description: Bad parameters

404.description: No such album, or not this caller's to change

204.description: Unlocked; the grant cookie is set

404.description: No such password album

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/auth/api-keys`: the caller's keys, revoked ones included.

201.description: Created; the secret is in this response only

422.description: Bad label, or too many keys

delete.summary: `DELETE /api/v2/auth/api-keys/{id}`: revoke one of the caller's keys.

404.description: Not one of the caller's keys

get.summary:
`GET /api/v2/auth/challenge`: a proof-of-work challenge for the widget.
Rate limited per address: making one costs the server a key derivation.

200.description: A signed ALTCHA v2 challenge for the widget

429.description: Too many challenges from this address

200.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set

403.description: Failed proof-of-work, banned, or not our page

post.summary:
`POST /api/v2/auth/logout`: end this session, and clear the cookie
whether or not there was one.

204.description: Signed out; the session cookie is cleared

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/auth/me`: the signed-in user, or 401.

200.description: The account as it now is

409.description: That email belongs to another account

422.description: Bad fields

post.summary:
`POST /api/v2/auth/password`: change it, and sign every other session
out. A browser session only — an API key cannot change a password.

401.description: Not signed in in a browser, or the current password is wrong

422.description: The new password is too weak

403.description: Registration closed, failed proof-of-work, or not our page

422.description: Invalid username, email or password

429.description: Too many registrations from this address

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/auth/sessions`: where the caller is signed in.

404.description: Not one of the caller's sessions

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/config`: what this caller may do, before a byte leaves.

404.description: Not there, or not for this caller

422.description: Bad parameters

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/files`: the public gallery.

404.description: Not there, or not for this caller

422.description: Bad parameters

post.summary:
`POST /api/v2/files/bulk`: one action over many files. Each file
succeeds or fails on its own; the response says which.

422.description: No ids, too many, or a bad body

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/files/{id}`: the file if the caller may see it, else 404.

404.description: Not there, or not for this caller

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v2/files/{id}`: as the owner, a moderator or an admin, or —
for anyone — with the upload's delete token in `X-Delete-Token`. The file
is retained for audit and its bytes quarantined; only an administrator
can restore or purge it.

parameters.name: X-Delete-Token
parameters.description: The token from the upload's delete link

404.description: No such file, or not this caller's to delete

200.description: The file as it now is

404.description: No such file, or not this caller's to change

422.description: Bad fields, or a stop word

post.summary:
`POST /api/v2/files/{id}/view`: count a view of the file's page. The
web app sends it once per visit; plain reads of the file are not views.

204.description: Counted, or already counted for this viewer lately

404.description: Not there, or not for this caller

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/licence`: the instance id and the licence. Administrators.

put.summary:
`PUT /api/v2/licence`: install a key. It must be signed by Haloid and
issued for this instance; it applies at once.

422.description: Not a valid key for this instance

204.description: Removed; the instance runs as Community

get.summary:
`GET /api/v2/metrics`: Prometheus text format. For an administrator, or
for a scraper holding `HALOID_METRICS_TOKEN` as its bearer token.

401.description: No admin key and no metrics token

get.summary:
`GET /api/v2/moderation/queue`: files held for review, oldest first.
Moderators and administrators.

404.description: No such file

post.summary:
`POST /api/v2/moderation/{id}/deny`: refuse a held file, which deletes
it with reason `moderation`.

404.description: No such file

get.summary:
`GET /api/v2/settings`: every setting, its value, default and whether
the environment pins it. Administrators.

patch.summary:
`PATCH /api/v2/settings`, a map of key to new value. All or nothing: an
unknown key, a bad value or a pinned key refuses the whole write. Live
before the response.

200.description: Every setting, as it now is

422.description: Refused; `errors` says which keys and why

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/settings/watermark`: the current watermark image.

404.description: No watermark is set

put.summary:
`PUT /api/v2/settings/watermark`, the image as the body: set the mark
that `watermark.enabled` stamps. A still image, at most 5 MiB.

422.description: Not a still image

204.description: Removed; nothing is stamped until another is set

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/storages`. Administrators.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v2/storages`: add a storage. Checked first, and in use as
soon as it is saved.

422.description: A configuration that cannot work

patch.summary:
`PATCH /api/v2/storages/{id}`: replace a storage's settings. Takes
effect as soon as it is saved.

404.description: No such storage

422.description: A configuration that cannot work

post.summary: `POST /api/v2/storages/{id}/retire`: no new uploads; it keeps serving.

404.description: No such storage

post.summary:
`POST /api/v2/storages/{id}/test`: write, read, serve, quarantine,
release and delete a probe object, reporting each step. Administrators
only.

404.description: No such storage

get.summary:
`GET /api/v2/updates`: this build, the release on offer, and whether it
can be installed. Administrators.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v2/updates/check`: look for a release now. A failed look is
reported in `error`, not as an error response.

`POST /api/v2/updates/install`: install the release on offer. Answers
once it has started; the server then restarts into it. Back up the
database first: migrations run on start and are not undone by a
rollback.

409.description: An update is already under way

422.description: Nothing on offer, or this install cannot update itself

post.summary:
`POST /api/v2/uploads`, multipart: a `file` (or a `url` to fetch it
from, where the instance allows that), and optionally `title`,
`description`, `tags` (comma-separated or repeated), `album`, `nsfw`,
`expires_in` (seconds) and `width`.

200.description: The same bytes were uploaded before; that file is returned

401.description: A bearer key that is wrong or revoked

403.description: Uploads are off for this caller, or a cookie request not from our page

413.description: Over this caller's size or pixel limit

422.description: Not an accepted type, unreadable, or bad fields

403.description: Uploads are off for this caller

422.description: Bad fields, or an album that is not the caller's

get.summary:
`GET /api/v2/uploads/sessions/{id}`: what has arrived. Ask before
resuming.

404.description: No such session for this caller, or expired
No such session for this caller

put.summary:
`PUT /api/v2/uploads/sessions/{id}/chunks/{n}`, the chunk's bytes as the
body. Chunks count from 0; sending one again replaces it.

200.description: Received; what the session now holds

404.description: No such session for this caller, or expired

422.description: No such chunk, or the wrong length

post.summary:
`POST /api/v2/uploads/sessions/{id}/complete`: assemble and upload,
answering as `POST /api/v2/uploads` does.

200.description: The same bytes were uploaded before; that file is returned

404.description: No such session for this caller, or expired

422.description: Chunks missing, or the file was refused

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/users/{username}`.

404.description: Not there, or not for this caller

422.description: Bad parameters

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/users/{username}/albums`: top-level albums.

404.description: Not there, or not for this caller

422.description: Bad parameters

get.summary: `GET /api/v2/users/{username}/files`.

404.description: Not there, or not for this caller

422.description: Bad parameters

AlbumPatch.description:
Fields to change on an album. Leave a field out to keep it; send `null`
to clear a description or move the album to the top level.

cover.description:
The file to show on the album's card, one of its own; `null` goes
back to its first picture.

parent.description: A new parent album, or `null` for the top level.

password.description:
Needed to make an album a password album; replaces the password of
one that already is.

can_edit.description: Whether this caller may edit, rearrange and delete the album.

cover.description:
A small picture for the album's card: its chosen cover, else its
first picture or video. `null` for an album with nothing to show.

prefix.description: The start of the key, all that is ever shown again.

album.description: For `move`: the album, or `null` for none.

code.description: The problem code it would have had alone: `not_found`, …

ConfigView.description:
What the frontend needs before a byte leaves: whether this caller may
upload, how much, and what.

branding.description:
Whether "Powered by Haloid" is shown: true unless a licence removes
it.

theme.description: The site's default theme, for a visitor who has not picked one.

secret.description: The whole key. Shown this once; only its hash is kept.

FilePatch.description:
Fields to change on a file. Leave a field out to keep it; send `null`
to clear a title, description or album.

album.description: An album id of the file owner's, or `null` for none.

delete.description:
The one-shot delete link. Only in the response to the upload that
created the file.

can_edit.description:
Whether this caller may edit and delete the file: its owner, a
moderator or an administrator.

owner.description:
The owner's username, on a single file; `null` for a guest's upload
and in lists.

views.description:
Views of its page, one per viewer per half hour; the owner's own
views are not counted.

width.description: Display dimensions, after rotation. Zero for audio.

Kind.description: What sort of file it is.

from_environment.description: Set by `HALOID_LICENCE_KEY`, so not changeable here.

instance_id.description: This instance's id: what a key is issued for.

pro.description: Whether Pro features may be put to new use.

storage_kinds.description: The kinds of storage this build can use: `local`, and `s3` in Pro.

unavailable_storages.description: Storages this build cannot load, by name: they need the Pro build.

MeView.description: The signed-in user, as they see themselves.

is_private.description: Whether the profile is hidden from everyone else.

parent.description: A parent album's id, for a nested album.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the file expires; absent or 0 for never.

size.description: The whole file's size in bytes, held to this caller's limit now.

files.description:
File ids in their new order. Files left out follow, in their current
order; ids not in the album are ignored.

PageView_AdminUserView.description:
One page of a list. `next` is the cursor for the page after, `null` on
the last.

PageView_AlbumView.description:
One page of a list. `next` is the cursor for the page after, `null` on
the last.

can_edit.description: Whether this caller may edit, rearrange and delete the album.

cover.description:
A small picture for the album's card: its chosen cover, else its
first picture or video. `null` for an album with nothing to show.

PageView_FileView.description:
One page of a list. `next` is the cursor for the page after, `null` on
the last.

can_edit.description:
Whether this caller may edit and delete the file: its owner, a
moderator or an administrator.

owner.description:
The owner's username, on a single file; `null` for a guest's upload
and in lists.

views.description:
Views of its page, one per viewer per half hour; the owner's own
views are not counted.

width.description: Display dimensions, after rotation. Zero for audio.

PageView_QueuedFileView.description:
One page of a list. `next` is the cursor for the page after, `null` on
the last.

ProblemBody.description:
The problem-details body, for the OpenAPI document. Every v2 error
response is one of these with `Content-Type: application/problem+json`.

code.description: Stable, for clients to branch on: `not_found`, `too_large`, …

errors.description: Per-field messages, when the request had invalid fields.

ProfilePatch.description:
What a user may change about themselves. Leave a field out to keep it;
`null` clears a display name or email.

chunk_size.description: Every chunk but the last is exactly this long.

received.description: Chunk numbers the server holds. The only record that counts.

pinned.description: Set in the environment, and read-only here.

detail.description: What happened, in words an operator can act on.

config.description: The kind's own settings: bucket, endpoint, paths. Never credentials.

enabled.description:
False when this build cannot update itself (in a container, the
image is upgraded instead); then nothing else here applies.

installable.description: Whether a release can be installed here.

allowed.description: Whether this caller may upload at all.

UploadForm.description: The multipart upload form, for the document.

url.description:
Instead of `file`: a URL to fetch it from, where the instance allows
URL uploads (`uploads.url_sources` in `/api/v2/config`).

width.description: Shrink the served image to this width, keeping the original.

duplicate.description: Whether an earlier upload of the same bytes was returned instead.

UserView.description: A user as anyone may see them.

tags.name: account
tags.description: Your own account: profile, password, keys, sessions
